<!-- Pocket Buddy+ pull request template -->

## What changed

Describe the product or platform change.

## Why

Describe the user-facing or developer-facing problem being solved.

## Verification

List the exact checks, CI runs, package builds, or smoke tests used.

## Delivery

For release-worthy desktop changes, merge only after Pocket Buddy+ CI is green. A successful `main` push is then shipped by the Pocket Buddy+ Release workflow and verified against GitHub's latest-release endpoint.
